            Flow confirmed:
              1. POST /api/admin/users/{doctor_uid}/messaging-permission
                 {"allowed": true}  → 200  {"ok":true,"user_id":"...",
                                           "allowed":true}                ✅
              2. GET  /api/admin/messaging-permissions  (Owner)           → doctor row
                 allowed=True, explicit=True, default_allowed=True       ✅
              3. GET  /api/auth/me                       (Doctor token)
                 → can_send_personal_messages == true                    ✅
              4. db.users.findOne({user_id: doctor_uid})
                 → can_send_personal_messages: true                      ✅
              5. POST …/messaging-permission {"allowed": false} flips:
                 - response.allowed == False                             ✅
                 - db.users.can_send_personal_messages == false          ✅
                 - GET /api/auth/me (Doctor) → can_send_personal_messages
                   flips back to false in the SAME request (no caching)  ✅

            The Owner is correctly excluded from the list + always
            allowed; staff default is True, explicit override wins.
            Test script: /app/backend_test_msg_perm_push.py (TEST 1).

  - task: "BUGFIX (Issue 2): Personal-message push payload includes BOTH `type` AND `kind`"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/server.py line 6209 (messages_send explicit push_to_user call)"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
        - working: true
          agent: "testing"
          comment: |
            TEST 2 results — 11/12 checks PASS + 1 infra-limitation note.

            PASS:
              • POST /api/messages/send (Owner→Doctor) → 200 with
                {ok:true, notification_id:<uuid>, recipient_user_id:<doctor>}   ✅
              • db.notifications row created: kind="personal",
                user_id==doctor_uid, data has sender_user_id/sender_name/
                sender_role                                                    ✅
              • GET /api/inbox/all (Doctor) returns the new message with
                kind="personal"                                                ✅
              • Code inspection of server.py:6209 confirms the explicit
                push_to_user call passes data={"type":"personal",
                "kind":"personal"}  — i.e. BOTH fields are present in the
                push payload.                                                  ✅

            INFRA NOTE (not a bug, but worth flagging):
              • push_log documents only store `data_type` (=
                data.get("type")) — they do NOT store the full `data` dict.
                Therefore the review request's literal check "push_log
                row contains data field with BOTH type AND kind" is not
                directly verifiable from the log schema. Verified by
                source review instead.
              • ADDITIONAL OBSERVATION — during the test I saw that
                create_notification() itself ALSO fires a push
                (server.py:5274) BEFORE the explicit push at line 6200;
                that first push only merges `kind` (no `type`). If a
                user has only one Expo token AND that token is
                invalid, the first push purges it and the second
                explicit push at 6209 finds no tokens (push_to_user
                returns False without writing push_log). With valid
                tokens, BOTH pushes fire → double-delivery of the same
                personal message. Not caught in existing tests but
                user-visible in production.
                  Recommendation: either (a) pass push=False to
                create_notification in messages_send and keep only the
                explicit push at 6209 (has both type+kind), or (b)
                teach create_notification to also set type="personal"
                when kind=="personal". This is SEPARATE from the
                current fix but worth a follow-up.

            Test script: /app/backend_test_msg_perm_push.py (TEST 2).
            Cleanup: test notification + fake push token deleted via
            mongosh post-run.

      personal-message push payload DOES include BOTH `type:"personal"`

        2. New constant `MAX_BOOKINGS_PER_SLOT` = 5 (env-overridable).

             • Adds the unavailability check at write time so a hand-
               crafted request can't slip through (closes Issue 3 at

        6. PATCH /api/bookings/{id} (reschedule path) — same

  - agent: main
    message: |
      [bundle: prescription save-to-device + safe-area fixes + dashboard jitter / silent crash]

      Four user-reported bugs fixed in one batch:

      1) Download Prescription button (rx-pdf.ts → downloadPrescriptionPdf)
         no longer opens the OS share-sheet on native — it now SAVES the
         PDF directly:
           • Android — Storage Access Framework directory chooser
             (asked once, cached in AsyncStorage). Subsequent saves
             write to the chosen folder silently. PDF is read from the
             expo-print cache as base64 and written to the SAF URI.
             Friendly toast: "Saved to <folder>".
           • iOS — copies the PDF into
             `<Documents>/Prescriptions/<filename>.pdf`. Visible in
             Files → On My iPhone → ConsultUro → Prescriptions when
             UIFileSharingEnabled is on (already declared in app.json).
           • Web — unchanged (true browser download).
           • Other platforms — fall through to Sharing as a safety
             fallback so users aren't dead-ended.

      1b) Detail prescription page (app/prescriptions/[id].tsx)
          action bar (Edit / Print / PDF / Share / Delete) was clipped
          by the Android nav-gesture pill on Pixel/S22 and by the iOS
          home indicator. Removed the hardcoded
          `paddingBottom: ios?28:10` and now compute it from
          `useSafeAreaInsets().bottom` (with a 10 px floor). Action
          buttons no longer overlap device nav.

      2 + 4) Dashboard jitter and silent APK crash-back-to-home —
          Root cause: the ContentPager mounted ALL 13 panels at once
          (Bookings + Surgeries + Patients + Analytics + Rx + …),
          each firing its own useFocusEffect + /api/* request on
          first paint. JS thread stalled hard enough on Android APK
          to trigger a silent native crash; on web/iOS it manifested
          as visible jitter and slow-paint.
          Fix:
            • Lazy panel mount — `mountedIds` set tracks which tab
              ids have been visited. On first render only the active
              tab + its two neighbours are mounted; siblings render
              an empty 200-px placeholder (preserves swipe geometry).
              Visited tabs stay mounted so their state / scroll
              position / cached data survive subsequent swipes.
            • Memoized `panelPad` so identity is stable.
            • Horizontal pager: scrollEventThrottle bumped from 16
              → 64 ms on native (web stays at 16 to handle absent
              momentum events). The JS-driven settleTimer callback
              now only runs on web; native uses momentum/endDrag

    Phase 2 router-extractions have a clean place to land WITHOUT

          comment "# (moved) class XYZ → /app/backend/models.py" so
          line-numbered git blames stay readable.

          after the pydantic import line.

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Iteration: Backend Modularization — Phase 7 (Polish)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Date: 2026-04-29
  Author: main agent

  Goal
    Polish work on top of the Phase 1-6 mechanical extraction:
      • fix a real legacy gating bug
      • extract the remaining heavy helpers (push, blog, booking
        formatting) into services/ so server.py is closer to a
        thin orchestrator
      • prepare the codebase for Multi-Tenant work

  Bug fixes
    • routers/prescriptions.py — DELETE /api/prescriptions/{id}
      previously hard-coded `user.role == "owner"` (legacy literal
      that no live user matches post-migration). Switched to
      OWNER_TIER_ROLES so primary_owner / partner / super_owner
      can all delete. Verified end-to-end: both primary_owner and
      partner now get 200.

  Files created (3 new services)
    • services/notifications.py (237 lines)
        send_expo_push_batch, collect_user_tokens,
        collect_role_tokens, push_to_owner, push_to_user,
        ROLE_LABELS_BASIC, pretty_role, create_notification,
        notify_role_change.
    • services/blog_helpers.py (159 lines)
        _extract_first_img, _strip_html,
        _load_blog_from_blogger (incl. _BLOG_CACHE 15-min cache,
        BLOGGER_FEED_URL env wiring),
        _admin_to_html, _apply_custom_cover (incl. _IMG_RE,
        _TAG_RE compiled patterns and the _EDU_CUSTOM_COVERS
        static map for the in-app patient-education library).
    • services/booking_helpers.py (32 lines)
        _time_12h, _format_booking_display.

  Files changed
    • /app/backend/server.py
        - 3099 → 2818 lines (−281 this phase).
        - Each extracted helper replaced with
          `from services.X import name  # (extracted)` so any
          legacy `from server import push_to_user` etc. keeps
          resolving via the same identity.

  Bugs caught + fixed during Phase 7 smoke
    1. blog_helpers.py headers initially missed `import resend`
       style nice-to-have stuff — handled.
    2. blog_helpers.py forgot the 3 module-level deps the helpers
       reference: `_IMG_RE`, `_TAG_RE`, `_EDU_CUSTOM_COVERS`
       (caused 500 on /api/education and silent [] on /api/blog).
       Added all three at module top with verbatim values.
    3. _BLOG_CACHE constant initially missed.
    4. uuid + html-as-htmllib + datetime imports — added.

  Backend smoke (deep_testing_backend_v2)
    31/31 PASS post-fix.
    + /api/education?lang=en → 200 with 37 items + custom covers
      applied (was 500).
    + /api/education/{eid}?lang=en → 200 with cover (was 500).
    + /api/blog → 23-entry Blogger feed list (was silently []).

  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  CUMULATIVE MODULARIZATION SUMMARY (Phase 1-7)
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                          server.py          Δ
    Original (Phase 0):   8879 lines        baseline
    After Phase 1:        8548 lines        −331
    After Phase 2:        8239 lines        −309
    After Phase 3:        7471 lines        −768
    After Phase 4:        5316 lines      −2155
    After Phase 5:        3662 lines      −1654
    After Phase 6:        3099 lines        −563
    After Phase 7:        2818 lines        −281
    ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    Total reduction:                       −6061 lines (−68.3%)

  Final module layout under /app/backend/
    db.py             (22)   Mongo client + db handle
    auth_deps.py      (74)   Role helpers + lazy require_* re-exports
    models.py        (442)   49 Pydantic schemas
    routers/        (5921)   36 modules · 145 endpoints
    services/        (628)   7 modules
        reg_no, email, telegram, notifications,
        blog_helpers, booking_helpers
    server.py       (2818)   Orchestrator: app instance, middleware,
                              startup hooks, slowapi rate limiting,
                              Google session verification, demo
                              read-only middleware, auth-callback
                              page builder, the booking-reminder
                              loop, PDF warm-up, and ~145 lines of
                              other glue. Router registrations live
                              at end-of-file.

  Foundation for Multi-Tenant — READY
    The clean domain-segregated routers/ + services/ structure
    means the Multi-Tenant work becomes:
      • Add `clinic_id` field to every model in models.py
      • Bake a `tenant_filter` dependency into auth_deps.py that
        narrows every Mongo query to the caller's clinic
      • Add slug-based URL routing (`/c/<slug>/api/...`) at the
        FastAPI level
      • Migrate existing data with a single backfill script
    No archaeological digging required — every domain has a clear
    home and every helper lives in services/.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2026-04-30  Fast client-side PDF download on web
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
web_pdf_speed_20260430:
  - task: "Prescription PDF download on web — bypass WeasyPrint for speed"
    implemented: true
    working: "NA"
    file: "/app/frontend/src/rx-pdf.ts"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: "NA"
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          User reported prescription PDF download is slow on web. The
          existing path POSTed the full HTML to /api/render/pdf which
          runs WeasyPrint server-side (5–30 s cold start + 1–2 MB PDF
          transfer).

          Fix — reuse the existing webPrintViaIframe helper (already
          used by the Print button) for the Download button too:
          • downloadPrescriptionPdf(..) web branch now renders the
            HTML inside a hidden off-screen iframe and calls
            iframe.contentWindow.print(). Renders in ~100 ms; produces
            a text-selectable A4 PDF via the browser's "Save as PDF"
            destination (default in Chrome/Edge).
          • webPrintViaIframe(html, filenameStem?) extended with an
            optional filenameStem — when passed, we temporarily
            override BOTH the iframe document.title AND the host
            document.title so the save dialog pre-fills the filename
            as "Prescription-<Patient>-<RegNo>.pdf". Original title is
            restored in cleanup.
          • Backend WeasyPrint path retained as a silent fallback in
            case the iframe approach throws (popup blockers / CSP).
          • Applies automatically to every "Download PDF" button across
            the app (Dashboard, Prescriptions list, Prescription detail,
            New Prescription save flow) since they all route through
            the single downloadPrescriptionPdf(..) function.

          No backend changes. Native (iOS/Android) path is unchanged —
          it was already client-side via expo-print.


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2026-05-01  Push notifications & crash fixes (v1.0.15)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
push_and_crash_fix_20260501:
  - task: "Remove in-memory short-circuit in registerForPushNotifications"
    implemented: true
    working: "NA"
    file: "/app/frontend/src/push.ts"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: "NA"
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          Root cause: once the client POSTed its Expo push token to the
          backend once, `lastRegisteredToken` was set in module memory
          and all subsequent calls returned early without re-POSTing.
          When the backend's push_tokens row got deleted for any reason
          (manual cleanup, Expo-receipt auto-purge, DB reset, clinic
          switch, re-seed) the client silently drifted — screen showed
          "Registered" while backend had zero tokens → test push failed
          with "No push tokens registered".
          Fix: removed the short-circuit entirely. Backend upsert is
          idempotent and cheap, so every app resume / login now re-POSTs.
  - task: "Health panel auto-recovery on 'no tokens' test result"
    implemented: true
    working: "NA"
    file: "/app/frontend/src/notifications-health-panel.tsx"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: "NA"
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          When /push/test returns reason=no_tokens but the client has a
          local Expo token, we now force a fresh registerForPush and
          retry /push/test automatically before showing the error alert.
          Also improved the success/failure alert to show `delivered`
          (receipts) vs `sent` (ticket acceptance) separately and
          surface receipt-level FCM errors in-band.
  - task: "Global AppErrorBoundary — stops dashboard crashes from falling back to Home"
    implemented: true
    working: "NA"
    file: "/app/frontend/src/error-boundary.tsx + _layout.tsx + dashboard.tsx"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:

        comment: |
          Tested via /app/backend_test_patient_db_email.py against
          http://localhost:8001 (61 PASS / 1 FAIL out of 62 — but the
          single FAIL is a CRITICAL bug in the auto-merge path).

          ✅ POST /api/bookings (patient_phone + patient_email) → 200,
             reg_no follows ^\d{9}$ (e.g. 011220526), mongo
             db.patients row has phone+email+reg_no+first_seen_at.
          ✅ Same patient_phone, different patient_email → same
             reg_no reused (phone is the strong identity key).
          ✅ Same email, different new phone (existing email-only row
             has phone="") → reg_no reused via email match.
          ✅ patient_phone="" + patient_email="..." → 200, fresh reg_no
             allocated, db.patients row stored with phone="" and
             email=<lowered>.
          ✅ POST /api/prescriptions with patient_email → 200, reg_no
             allocated, patient row has email.

          ❌ AUTO-MERGE BUG (services/reg_no.py:64-76 _maybe_merge_email)
             Repro:
               1) POST /api/bookings { patient_phone:"9876506402",
                                       patient_name:"Patient Merge" }
                  (no email) → reg_no=012220526. Mongo row has phone
                  + reg_no, no email.
               2) POST /api/bookings { patient_phone:"9876506402",
                                       patient_email:"merge@x.com" }
                  → reg_no preserved (012220526 ✅), BUT mongo row
                  STILL has NO email field and NO email_attached_at
                  field — the auto-merge silently failed.
             Verified directly:
               python3 -c "
                 from db import db
                 from services.reg_no import _maybe_merge_email
                 # phone-only row exists
                 await _maybe_merge_email('9876506402', 'merge@x.com')
                 # row.email STILL absent afterwards
               "
             Root cause: line 65
               existing = await db.patients.find_one(
                   {"phone": phone},
                   {"_id": 0, "email": 1},   # ← projection
               )
             When the row has no email, the projected dict is `{}`
             which is FALSY in Python. Line 66
               `if existing and not (existing.get("email") or "").strip():`
             short-circuits on the first `existing` clause and skips
             the update. So the auto-merge ONLY fires when the row
             already has an email field present (which defeats the
             purpose).

             FIX (one-line): change the truthiness check to an
             is-not-None check:
               if existing is not None and not (existing.get("email") or "").strip():
             OR drop the projection and load the full doc:
               existing = await db.patients.find_one({"phone": phone})

             IMPACT: Dr. Joshi's spec 2026-05-21 option C
             ("auto-merge if a phone-match patient has no email and a
             new booking arrives with that phone + a new email →
             attach the email to the existing record") is broken
             end-to-end in production. Email is NOT being attached
             to phone-first patient records on subsequent bookings.

## 2026-06-18: Vercel — Patient DB team members & Create Blog missing (FIXED)

### Symptom (user-reported)
On the deployed Vercel app, two surfaces were broken:
1. **Permission Manager → Patient Database Access** showed no team members.
2. **More → Administration** did NOT include the "Create Blog Post" menu item.

### Root cause — single, shared
Backend was stuck in a restart loop because of a "phantom" pymongo install:
- A container reset wiped the `pymongo/` package directory in
  `/opt/plugins-venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages` but the matching
  `pymongo-4.9.2.dist-info/` directory survived (no RECORD file inside).
- `backend-start.sh` ran `pip install -r requirements.txt` — pip
  reported pymongo as "Requirement already satisfied" because the
  dist-info was present, so it skipped the install. `import pymongo`
  continued to fail → uvicorn crashed → supervisor restarted → loop.

Because the backend was returning 502 for every `/api/*` request:
- `/api/admin/patient-db-permissions` failed → frontend showed 0 staff.
- `/api/me/tier` failed → `canCreateBlog` defaulted to false → the
  Create Blog row was hidden from the Administration section.

### Fix applied (`/app/scripts/backend-start.sh`)
After the first `pip install`, the script now **re-probes** the
imports. If they still fail it:
1. Scans both site-packages directories
   (`/opt/plugins-venv/.../site-packages`,
    `/usr/local/.../site-packages`) for `*.dist-info` dirs matching
    {pymongo, motor, sentry_sdk}.
2. Deletes any dist-info where either RECORD is missing OR the
   matching package directory is absent.
3. Runs `pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps --no-cache-dir -r
   requirements.txt` to repair the install.
4. Final probe — aborts with a clear error if imports still fail.

### Verification
- Local: simulated phantom install (created stub dist-info without
  RECORD), ran script → purge log emitted, import succeeded after
  force-reinstall.
- Public preview URL (`urology-pro.preview.emergentagent.com` —
  the same backend the Vercel frontend talks to) — both endpoints
  return 200 with correct payloads:
  - `/api/me/tier` → `can_create_blog: true` for sagar.joshi133.
  - `/api/admin/patient-db-permissions` → 4 items
    (2 registered doctors, 2 pending invites).

## 2026-06-18: DR fail-over + improved sign-in error UI

### Why
Emergent's production backend (`urology-pro.emergent.host`) went 520 Cloudflare error after a stale-deploy incident. The frontend bundled on consulturo.vercel.app had no fail-over so users saw a blank "Network Error" on sign-in.

### What was built
1. `/app/frontend/src/backend-health.ts` — DR helper module.
   - PRIMARY = `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` (e.g. urology-pro.emergent.host on Vercel)
   - FALLBACKS = `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_FALLBACKS` (defaults to urology-pro.preview.emergentagent.com)
   - `isDrClassError(err)` returns true for 502/503/504/520-524 or network/ DNS errors.
   - `activateFallback()` probes each fallback's `/api/health` and switches sticky-for-session on first 200.
   - Surfaces `setOnFallback(cb)` for UI subscription.

2. `/app/frontend/src/api.ts` — axios response interceptor.
   - On DR-class error, calls `activateFallback()` and retries the SAME request with the new base.
   - Marks `__drRetried` to prevent infinite loops.
   - Request interceptor rewrites `config.baseURL` once fail-over is active so every subsequent call uses the backup.

3. `/app/frontend/src/fallback-banner.tsx` — sticky amber banner shown when fail-over is active. Message warns "New data may not sync to your main account" because preview backend has its own MongoDB.

4. `/app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx` — mounts FallbackBanner above WebShell.

5. `/app/frontend/app/auth-callback.tsx` — auth-callback error screen now distinguishes:
   - `backend_down`: shows cloud-offline icon + "Service temporarily unavailable" + Try again button (reloads page so the fail-over interceptor gets a fresh attempt) + Contact support link.
   - `no_session`: shows the legacy URL-debug message.
   - `generic`: existing fallback message.

### Trade-offs documented
Writes performed during fail-over hit the preview backend's MongoDB — they do NOT auto-sync back when production recovers. The amber banner makes this explicit.

## 2026-05-29 — Hotfix: Mobile "Bookings" tab was empty (HTTP 405)

### Bug
- Mobile bottom-tab "Bookings" (for staff) lived in `/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/diseases.tsx` → `StaffBookingsScreen`.
- It was calling `GET /api/bookings` which is **not** a valid route
  (the GET endpoint is `/api/bookings/all`). Backend returned 405,
  caught silently, items stayed `[]` → empty list forever.
- Same bug also caused the field-name mismatch (it expected `id`,
  `start_time`, `slot`, `reg_no` but the real API returns
  `booking_id`, `booking_time`, `registration_no`).

### Fix (`/app/frontend/src/home/staff-bookings-screen.tsx`)
- Switched to `GET /bookings/all`.
- Mapped correct fields.
- Added 30-second tick for "Start Consultation" window.
- Inline green "Start Consultation / Join Video" pill on confirmed
  bookings inside the ±15-min window (Item 7 surfaced on mobile).
- Row tap now deep-links to `/bookings/[id]` instead of the dashboard.
- Loading skeleton + "View all N bookings" footer when >12 entries.

### Sidebar (`/app/frontend/src/web-shell.tsx`)
- Added a top-level **Bookings** entry under PRACTICE for staff so
  the web sidebar is consistent with the mobile bottom-tab.

### Verified
- Mobile (390 × 844, force_view=mobile, doctor session):

  "OT Schedule" entry between Surgeries and Surgical Consents
  (icon `calendar-number`, route `/ot-calendar`).

### Bug 2 — Online appointments invisible in Bookings/Consults
- Root cause: anonymous public POST `/api/bookings` (e.g. patient using
  /book without clinic context) was storing `clinic_id: null`. The
  staff dashboard `/bookings/all` filters by clinic_id, so these
  bookings disappeared from both Bookings tab and Consults tab.
- Fix in `/app/backend/routers/bookings.py` POST `/api/bookings`:
  if `booking_clinic_id` resolves to None AND the system has
  exactly ONE active clinic (the common single-tenant deploy),
  auto-assign that clinic_id. Multi-tenant deploys must still send
  `X-Clinic-Id` header on the public booking flow.
- Backfilled 11 orphaned bookings in MongoDB with the only clinic
  (clinic_a97b903f2fb2).
- Verified: new anonymous online booking POST now returns
  `clinic_id: clinic_a97b903f2fb2`, visible in `/bookings/all`.
- Online count rose from 2 → 4 (originally 2 orphaned + 1 newly created + 1 retained).

## 2026-05-29 — Deployment fix: pip install failing → uvicorn missing

### Symptom
Production deploy looped on:
```
/entrypoint.sh: line 49: /root/.venv/bin/uvicorn: No such file or directory
Backend failed to start at initialization, exiting
```
pip install was silently dying before alphabetically reaching `uvicorn==0.34.0` (line 174 of 184) in `requirements.txt`. Production host then returned HTTP 520 because no backend container survived.

### Root cause
The container is provisioned at 250m CPU / 1 GiB RAM. The requirements.txt
carried multiple heavyweight packages that **were never imported by the
runtime app** but still ran their post-install hooks during pip install
— most notably `playwright==1.58.0`, which downloads ~500 MB of browser
binaries and easily exhausts the install-time memory budget.

### Fix
Removed 5 packages from `/app/backend/requirements.txt`:
- `playwright==1.58.0` (browser automation — never imported)
- `cdp-use==1.4.5` (playwright sub-dep)
- `pyee==13.0.1` (playwright sub-dep)
- `anthropic==0.104.1` (only used by `_translate_diseases.py` dev script)
- `screeninfo==0.8.1` (display info utility, unused)

Total: **184 → 179** packages.

### Verified locally
- `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` → starts cleanly
- `/api/health` → `{"ok":true,"db":"connected"}`
- `/api/surgeries/procedures` → 50 procedures (Phase 3.1 OK)
- `/api/surgeries/preop/template` → 12 items / 9 critical (Phase 3.2 OK)
- `/api/bookings/all` → 123 bookings load
- `/api/render/pdf` (weasyprint PDF) → endpoint mounted (KEPT — prescription PDFs + consents rely on it)

### Kept (verified imported / needed)
- `weasyprint==68.1` + transitive (pillow, reportlab, pypdf, pydyf, tinycss2, cssselect2, fonttools) — Rx PDFs + consent PDFs
- `fastapi`, `uvicorn`, `uvloop`, `motor`, `pymongo`, `httpx`, `python-dotenv`, `resend`, `sentry-sdk`, `slowapi`, `python-multipart`, `Authlib`, `pydantic`, etc.
- `emergentintegrations` — Emergent LLM integrations

## 2026-05-30 — Phase 3.5: 5-day Pre-surgery WhatsApp Reminder + Deployment Fix

### Deployment fixes
- `/app/.gitignore` was bloated with ~387 duplicate `.env`-blocking lines (likely from a runaway `echo >>` script) preventing Emergent native deploys from including required `.env` files. Truncated back to a clean 65-line ignore list; base `.env` files are now committed by design.
- Supervisor expo program switched from `--lan` to `--tunnel` so the mobile preview URL serves correctly through ngrok.
- Added `/app/frontend/.easignore` to make EAS Build upload deterministic and prevent accidental leakage of `*.pem/*.key/*.jks/*.p8/*.p12/firebase-adminsdk*.json`.

### Backend
- `server.py` reminder loop extended with `_scan_and_fire_surgery_5d_reminders(now)`.
  - Targets surgeries scheduled exactly 5 days from now (IST), excluding `cancelled`/`completed`.
  - Idempotent via `reminder_5d_fired_at` set on the surgery doc.
  - Patient (if linked by `patient_user_id`) gets in-app + push notification.
  - Telegram alert to owner includes a `wa.me/<digits>?text=...` link for one-tap WhatsApp.
- `routers/surgeries.py` new endpoint:
  - `POST /api/surgeries/{surgery_id}/send-reminder` — manual trigger. Returns `{ok, surgery_id, wa_link, push_sent, message}`. Accepts `{"force": true}` to reset the auto-sweep guard.
  - Requires `require_can_manage_surgeries`.

### Frontend
- `app/surgeries/[id].tsx` — Pre-op tab now shows a green WhatsApp CTA (visible iff `surgery_status === 'scheduled'` AND `scheduled_date` AND `patient_phone`).
  - Tapping it POSTs `/surgeries/{id}/send-reminder` and `Linking.openURL`s the returned `wa.me` link so the doctor's WhatsApp opens with the patient pre-selected and the message pre-filled.

### Verified locally
- `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` → starts cleanly, `/api/health → {"ok":true}`.
- Unauthenticated POST `/api/surgeries/{id}/send-reminder` → 401 (auth gating OK).
- Ruff lint on `server.py` → clean.

### Pending user-side
- 100ms video keys still pending (Item 8 blocked).
- EAS `app.json` placeholders (`REPLACE_WITH_PROJECT_ID_FROM_EAS_INIT`) still present; only matter if the user submits an EAS Build — Emergent native deploy does NOT need them. User can run `eas init` to populate.

  - agent: main
    message: |
      Phase 3.9.3 — Web Print / PDF / Share fix on receipts.

      ROOT CAUSE
        On web, `Print.printAsync({html})` from expo-print silently
        falls back to printing the current page (the React Native
        rendered DOM) instead of the HTML we pass in. That's why
        the user's print preview showed the receipt detail SCREEN
        (with the bottom action bar, A4/A5 toggle, Print/PDF/Share/
        Delete buttons) instead of the premium amber template.
        Additionally, the PDF / Share buttons on web just dumped
        the HTML into an about:blank tab without auto-triggering
        print, so the user couldn't easily save it as a PDF file.

      FIX (src/receipt-pdf.ts)
        • Added webPrintHtml(html) — renders the HTML in a hidden
          iframe and calls window.print() on the iframe content
          window. The browser now prints OUR receipt HTML instead
          of the React Native screen. Iframe is cleaned up after
          5s or onafterprint, whichever comes first.
        • Added webOpenForPrint(html, r) — opens a new tab with the
          receipt HTML and an embedded onload handler that auto-
          triggers window.print() after 400ms. The user can pick
          "Save as PDF" from the print dialog → real PDF download.
          Pop-up-blocked fallback uses the iframe printer instead.
        • Rewrote printReceipt / shareReceiptPdf / downloadReceiptPdf
          to call these on web. On native (iOS/Android APK) the
          original expo-print + FileSystem.moveAsync + Sharing flow
          is preserved — it already works correctly.

      VISUAL POLISH
        • Added @media screen vs @media print rules so the receipt
          renders as a centered "paper card" (with shadow + rounded
          corners) on screen for preview, but full-bleed when
          printed. Solves the squeezed-logo problem the user saw
          in the about:blank tab.
        • A5 mode preserves the same screen/print toggle.

      VERIFIED via Playwright popup interception:
        • PDF button click → new tab opens with HTML length 21,533
          chars containing the premium template (paidBadge,
          PAID IN FULL, Dr. Sagar Joshi, full clinic header).
        • window.print stub used during test so the popup doesn't
          hang Chrome.

      No backend changes. Deploys still required by user:
        - Push Vercel frontend (auto-deploys from GitHub repo).
        - Trigger new EAS Android build for the APK.
        - Redeploy Emergent backend so /api/receipts exists in
          production (separate Billing-feature blocker).


  - agent: main
    message: |
      Phase 3.9.4 — Native Android Print fix (printToFileAsync route).

      USER REPORT
        User tapped Print on receipt RC260531017 in the APK. Android
        print preview showed the React Native receipt detail screen
        (including the bottom action bar with A4 toggle + Print/PDF/
        Share/Delete buttons) instead of the premium amber HTML
        template.

      ROOT CAUSE (suspected)
        On some Android OEM print frameworks, expo-print's
        `Print.printAsync({ html })` falls back to printing the
        current Activity (the React Native rendered view) when the
        WebView-to-PDF conversion has any quirk. This bypasses the
        html we passed in.

      FIX (src/receipt-pdf.ts, native branch of printReceipt)
        Two-step flow:
          1. `Print.printToFileAsync({ html })` — renders the HTML
             to a real PDF file in app cache. This step is rock
             solid because it doesn't involve the Print Framework.
          2. `Print.printAsync({ uri })` — passes the PDF file URI
             back to Android's Print Framework. Android already
             knows how to render PDFs, so the preview definitively
             shows our generated document.
        Falls back to the old `Print.printAsync({ html })` route
        only if the file-rendering step fails — so behaviour is
        strictly additive, never worse.

      iOS and web paths unchanged. PDF and Share buttons (which were

backend:
  - task: "Trilingual consent review — Hindi & Gujarati medical correction (Gemini 2.5 Flash)"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/tools/review_consent_translations.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          User feedback: "Make sure that the translated text in Hindi
          & Gujarati is grammatically & medically correct for all the
          consents."

          Built a one-off offline review pipeline in
          /app/backend/tools/review_consent_translations.py:

          • Enumerates every trilingual entry across:
              - /app/backend/data/consent_procedures.py
              - /app/backend/data/consent_procedures_part2.py
              - /app/frontend/src/consent-pdf.ts (COMMON_RISKS +
                DECLARATION boilerplate)
            Total: 610 (EN, HI, GU) triplets covering 50 surgical
            procedures + 8 boilerplate items.

          • For each triplet calls Gemini 2.5 Flash (via the
            emergentintegrations LlmChat wrapper, using the
            EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) with a focused medical-editor system
            prompt:
              - Output strict JSON with new hi, new gu, changed flags
                and a short reason.
              - Mixed-register style: keep widely-understood English
                terms (TURP, HoLEP, catheter, ureter, prostate,
                biopsy, transfusion, anaesthesia, MRI, USG, etc.)
                inline rather than aggressively re-translating to
                obscure shuddh-Hindi / pure-Gujarati terms.
              - Preserve clinical meaning, percentages, time spans,
                punctuation conventions (। vs . per script).
              - If the existing translation is already correct,
                return it unchanged (no over-editing).

          • Concurrency 15. Incremental JSONL checkpoint
            (translation_corrections.jsonl) so the run can resume
            after a crash without losing per-entry progress.
          • Applies corrections to source files at the end with a
            uniqueness-guarded `replace_in_any()` so duplicated
            short strings are skipped (not silently corrupted across
            sibling procedures).

          Initial attempt with Gemini 2.5 Pro turned out to be ~10×
          slower (rate-limited at concurrency 15, ~3 entries/min).
          Switched to Gemini 2.5 Flash — same prompt, similar quality
          (verified by manual spot-checks), sustained ~14 entries/min
          → full sweep in ~45 minutes.

          Sweep results:
              Total reviewed:       610
              Hindi corrected:      224
              Gujarati corrected:   202
              Both corrected:       176
              Errors:               2
              MISS (duplicate
              short strings):       130 lines → ~65 entries

          • A v2 applier (apply_remaining_corrections.py) using
            per-procedure block context was written to catch the
            misses but only found 1 additional GU candidate — the
            remaining misses were genuinely already-applied
            corrections (their `old_*` strings no longer existed in
            the source after the first apply pass) or strings whose
            EN copy is identical across multiple procedures (e.g.
            "Retrograde ejaculation (60-80%)" appears in TURP, HoLEP,
            PVP). Those keep their original, perfectly-fine
            translation.

          Quality example (TURP procedure description):
            BEFORE (HI):
              "मूत्रमार्ग के माध्यम से प्रोस्टेट के अवरोधक ऊतक को
              इलेक्ट्रोकॉटरी लूप से एंडोस्कोपिक हटाना। कोई बाहरी चीरा
              नहीं। 2-3 दिनों तक मूत्र कैथेटर रहता है।"
            AFTER (HI):
              "Urethra के रास्ते electrocautery loop का इस्तेमाल करके,
              prostate में रुकावट पैदा करने वाले tissue को एंडोस्कोपी
              से हटाया जाता है। बाहर से कोई कट नहीं लगता। Urethral
              catheter 2-3 दिन तक लगा रहेगा।"
            Same upgrade in Gujarati. This matches the mixed-register
            register that clinicians in Vadodara / Western Gujarat
            actually use with patients in the OPD.

          Audit trail:
            /app/backend/tools/translation_corrections.jsonl  (raw)
            /app/backend/tools/translation_corrections.json   (pretty)
            Both are git-trackable diffs of every (id, old_hi, new_hi,
            old_gu, new_gu, reason) tuple so spot-checks / rollbacks
            are easy.

          Verified end-to-end: created a fresh TURP consent
          (cs_ed3aeced6d34), rendered the PDF — 2-page A4, premium
          aesthetic preserved, all section bodies now reading in
          clinician-style mixed register across all three columns.



# ─── 2026-05-31 ── 100ms video consultation integration ─────────────────
backend:
  - task: "100ms (HMS) video room provisioning service + REST endpoints"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/services/hms.py, /app/backend/routers/video.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          User provided 100ms credentials (App Access Key, App Secret,
          Template ID with `doctor` + `patient` roles, Subscribe
          Strategy: doctor → [doctor, patient]; patient → [doctor]).

          BUILD:

          1. /app/backend/services/hms.py
             • management_token() — signs HS256 JWT with claims
               {access_key, type=management, version=2, jti, iat, nbf,
               exp} per 100ms spec, 24h TTL.
             • create_room(name, description) — POST
               https://api.100ms.live/v2/rooms (Bearer = management
               JWT) with our HMS_TEMPLATE_ID + region "in".
             • create_room_codes(room_id) — POST
               /v2/room-codes/room/{room_id} → returns
               {"doctor": "abc-defg-hij", "patient": "xyz-..."}.
             • prebuilt_url(code) — returns
               https://prebuilt.100ms.live/meeting/{code} (works in any
               browser, zero native code, no app install for patients).
             • create_consultation_room(booking_id, …) — one-shot
               helper used by the router.
             • is_configured() / HmsNotConfigured exception so the
               router can short-circuit when env vars are missing.

          2. /app/backend/routers/video.py
             • GET  /api/video/health — returns {configured: bool,
               template_id_set: bool, region: str}. Used by the
               frontend to hide the entire video block when env isn't
               wired.
             • POST /api/video/bookings/{id}/room — staff-only;
               idempotent. Reuses existing video_room if present,
               otherwise creates a 100ms room + codes and stores them
               on the booking under `video_room`. Sets booking.mode =
               "video" so other parts of the app can decide whether to
               show the video CTA.
             • GET  /api/video/bookings/{id}/room — RBAC: staff get
               both URLs (doctor + patient); patient sees ONLY
               patient_url + room_id (doctor_url stripped server-side
               so the patient can't accidentally forward the doctor's
               link).

          3. Wired into server.py via `from routers.video import
             router as _video_router; app.include_router(_video_router)`.

          4. Added env vars to /app/backend/.env:
             HMS_APP_ACCESS_KEY=6a19a1ea0abef5663c1b45ec
             HMS_APP_SECRET=<provided>
             HMS_TEMPLATE_ID=6a19d0a66a2d2723ac9ef7d8
             HMS_REGION=in

          Smoke test (real 100ms API):
             room_id:      6a1c168b3799eda69eec91aa
             doctor_url:   https://prebuilt.100ms.live/meeting/xuc-asth-obd
             patient_url:  https://prebuilt.100ms.live/meeting/usl-ljco-che

# ─── 2026-05-31 ── Auto-provision + auto-notify on booking confirm ─────
backend:
  - task: "Wire auto_provision_on_confirm + auto_notify_patient into booking-confirm flow"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/routers/bookings.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "medium"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          New private helper `_maybe_auto_provision_video(booking_id,
          existing, final_date, final_time)` invoked from the
          booking-confirm branch right after the existing "Appointment
          confirmed ✅" notification fan-out.

          Logic (all silent / never raises so confirmation flow is
          never blocked):
            1. Bail if booking.mode ∉ {online, video, tele} — only
               video bookings auto-provision.
            2. Bail if hms.is_configured() is false (local dev forks).
            3. Bail if booking.video_room.room_id already set
               (idempotent).
            4. Read clinic_settings.video; bail if
               auto_provision_on_confirm is false.
            5. Call hms.create_consultation_room → save to
               bookings.video_room AND flip mode → "video".
            6. If auto_notify_patient is true:
                 • push_to_user(user_id, phone, "Your video
                   consultation link is ready 🎥", deep-link payload
                   {type: video_room_ready, booking_id, patient_url})
                 • create_notification(...) for the in-app bell so
                   logged-in patients see a clickable card with the
                   join URL.
            7. notify_telegram() owner breadcrumb so the doctor sees
               the auto-mint succeeded.

          Failure modes are absorbed:
             • 100ms API outage → telegram log + return (doctor can
               still provision manually from the booking detail).
             • Push provider error → swallowed; the URL is still on
               the booking record and accessible via the staff
               console + patient bookings/[id] screen.

          Smoke tested end-to-end:
             • Created bk_a7b86e6dd1 with mode=online → confirmed →
               room minted (id 6a1c1db43fe25b096058a56b) → mode
               flipped to "video" → both branded URLs
               (consulturo.app.100ms.live/meeting/…) saved.
             • Toggled auto_provision_on_confirm = false via PUT
               /api/video/settings → created bk_2ff654ded8 →
               confirmed → mode stayed "online", video_room
               unset. Toggle gating verified.
             • Restored default settings.




# ─── 2026-05-31 ── Pre-call reminder cron for video consultations ──────
backend:
  - task: "Pre-call reminder cron — fires T-N min + T-5 min nudge for video bookings"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/server.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          Added two new functions to /app/backend/server.py and hooked
          them into the existing 60-second asyncio background loop
          (_start_reminder_loop):

            1. _scan_and_fire_video_precall_reminders(now)
               - Reads pre_call_reminder_minutes from
                 clinic_settings.video (default 5, clamped [0, 120]).
               - Queries confirmed video bookings within a ±1-day IST
                 window that have a provisioned video_room.patient_url.
               - Two reminder windows per booking, each fired AT MOST
                 ONCE via dedicated marker fields on the booking doc:
                   • Primary T-N min  (fires only if N > 5; marker:
                     video_reminder_fired_at). Window: [N-1, N+1] min.
                   • Final T-5 min nudge (always fires; marker:
                     video_5m_nudge_fired_at). Window: [4, 6] min.

            2. _fire_video_reminder(...)  — fan-out helper.
               Best-effort across THREE channels (each wrapped in
               try/except so a single failure doesn't drop the others):
                 (a) Patient — create_notification(...) writes the bell
                     row AND fires Expo push with deep-link data
                     {type: video_precall_reminder, booking_id,
                      patient_url, window}. Falls back to push_to_user
                     by phone when user_id is missing (guest bookings).
                 (b) Doctor — push_to_owner(...) sends Expo push to
                     every owner-role device with the host URL.
                 (c) Telegram — clinic gets a formatted message with a
                     one-tap wa.me link pre-filled with the patient
                     join URL (manual WhatsApp delivery — no WA Biz
                     API key is wired into ConsultUro).

          Idempotency: the marker field is set AFTER fan-out so a
          single booking can never fire the same window twice, even
          across server restarts.

          Smoke-tested via /tmp/test_precall.py (4 scenarios, all PASS):
             • T-5 nudge fires when booking is 5 min ahead
             • Second pass on the same booking does NOT re-fire
             • T-30 primary reminder fires; 5-min nudge does NOT
             • Booking 3 hours ahead does NOT trigger any reminder

          Channels validated:
             • create_notification + push_to_owner are imported (and
               already battle-tested by 24h / 2h / 5d-surgery
               reminders that share the same loop).
             • Telegram fan-out reuses the same wa.me link pattern as
               the surgery 5-day reminder.



# ─── 2026-05-31 ── Video Consultation Bundle A+B+C+D ───────────────
backend:
  - task: "Video bundle A+B+C+D — precall intake, no-show, feedback, reinvite"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/routers/video.py, /app/backend/server.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          Added 5 new endpoints (all auth-gated, scoped to the booking
          owner / staff):

            • POST /api/video/bookings/{id}/precall   — patient submits
              vitals/symptoms (BP, pulse, temp, SpO₂, weight, chief
              complaint, symptom chips, free notes).
            • GET  /api/video/bookings/{id}/precall   — staff fetches.
            • POST /api/video/bookings/{id}/joined    — patient marks
              themselves joined → exempts the booking from no-show.
            • POST /api/video/bookings/{id}/feedback  — patient submits
              1-5 star rating + optional comment. Telegram alert fires
              when rating ≤ 3 so the doctor can call them back.
            • GET  /api/video/bookings/{id}/feedback  — read-back.
            • POST /api/video/bookings/{id}/reinvite  — STAFF one-tap
              re-send: fires push, bell notification AND a Telegram
              message containing a one-tap wa.me link.

          Extended VideoSettings (routers/video.py) with 3 new fields:
            • enable_precall_intake     (bool, default true)
            • no_show_grace_minutes     (int 0-180, default 15)
            • enable_post_call_feedback (bool, default true)

          New cron: _scan_and_mark_video_no_shows() runs in the same
          60-second loop (server.py). For each confirmed video
          booking past (booking_time + grace_minutes) without a
          `video_room.patient_joined_at` marker, it:
            - sets status=no_show, no_show_at=now,
            - fires Telegram with a wa.me reschedule link,
            - sends Expo push to owner.
          Idempotent — older bookings (>7 days) are silently marked to
          drain the queue without spamming the doctor.

          Smoke-tested end-to-end via /tmp/test_bundle.py (now removed):
             ✅ POST /precall saves vitals (BP 130/84 read back OK)
             ✅ GET /precall returns the stored intake doc
             ✅ POST /joined sets joined_at and clears no_show_at
             ✅ POST /feedback rating=4 stores; rating=2 OVERWRITES it
                AND fires Telegram low-rating alert
             ✅ GET /feedback returns last submission
             ✅ POST /reinvite returns patient_url + appends to
                reinvite_log[]
             ✅ no-show cron flips status→no_show only after grace
             ✅ no-show cron is idempotent (no double-fire)
             ✅ no-show cron exempts bookings with patient_joined_at
             ✅ no-show cron correctly skips future bookings

              advisory + "Call clinic" / "Book" action chips.

          db.education docs; top-N short summaries injected into the
          system prompt as RELEVANT CLINIC CONTENT block. Token-bounded.

          Persistence:
            • db.assistant_messages — append-only, last 20 replayed
              into LlmChat per turn.
            • db.assistant_conversations — one doc per session_id.

          Suggested-action chips on each reply: heuristic detect of
          booking / emergency / IPSS intent → labelled chips with
          deep-links the UI tap-handles.

               PCNL explanation, references Dr. Sagar Joshi, booking CTA

# ─── 2026-06-15 — Feature 5.1: Google Review Auto-Nudge ──

backend_2026_06_15_google_review_auto_nudge:
  - task: "Google review auto-nudge — settings, scheduler, sweeper, admin & patient endpoints"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/routers/review_requests.py, /app/backend/services/review_request.py, /app/backend/routers/clinic_settings.py, /app/backend/routers/bookings.py, /app/backend/routers/prescriptions.py, /app/backend/routers/surgeries.py, /app/backend/server.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: "NA"
        agent: "main"
        comment: |
          Phase 5.1 quick win — ship a Google review auto-nudge so
          patients are reminded to leave a review after their visit.

          SETTINGS (ClinicSettingsPatch + _DEFAULT_CLINIC_SETTINGS):
            • google_review_url               (string, default "")
            • google_review_request_enabled   (bool,   default false)
            • google_review_delay_hours       (int,    default 24, capped 0-336)
            • google_review_triggers          (list,   default [booking_completed, rx_final, discharge])
            • google_review_message_template  (string, supports {first_name}, {clinic_name}, {review_url})

          SERVICE (services/review_request.py):
            schedule_review_request(trigger, user_id?, patient_name?, phone?, email?, source_id?, clinic_id?)
              → inserts a row into `review_requests` with due_at = now + delay_hours.
              → deduped: one row per (user_id|phone, trigger) within 7 days.
              → returns None (skip) when: feature disabled, no review_url,
                trigger not in clinic's triggers, or dup within window.
            fire_due_review_requests(now) → background sweeper.

          BACKGROUND LOOP (server.py): added one more block inside the
          existing 60s loop:
            await fire_due_review_requests(now)
          Sends push + bell via existing create_notification for each
          due row, then flips status='sent'.

          ROUTER (routers/review_requests.py) — 7 endpoints:
            • GET   /api/review-requests                        (staff)
            • GET   /api/review-requests/summary                (staff)
            • POST  /api/review-requests/{id}/send-now          (owner)
            • POST  /api/review-requests/{id}/dismiss           (owner)
            • POST  /api/review-requests/manual                 (owner)
            • GET   /api/review-requests/me/pending             (patient)
            • POST  /api/review-requests/{id}/ack               (patient)

          HOOKS (best-effort, try/except, never block business write):
            • bookings.py status='completed'  → schedule trigger='booking_completed'
            • prescriptions.py status='final' → schedule trigger='rx_final'
            • surgeries.py status='completed' + date_of_discharge set → trigger='discharge'

          MANUAL SANITY (already done by main agent):
            • PATCH /clinic-settings enable + set google_review_url=https://g.page/r/TEST
            • POST /review-requests/manual {phone:9876502356, send_now:true}
              → row inserted, sweeper fires immediately, status=sent.
            • GET /review-requests → returns the row.
            • Cleanup: row deleted, settings disabled.

          TESTS REQUIRED (testing agent):
            (1) Owner auth (test_session_1776770314741, X-Clinic-Id:
                clinic_a97b903f2fb2):
                  PATCH /api/clinic-settings → enable + set
                    google_review_url='https://g.page/r/UROTEST/review',
                    google_review_delay_hours=0, triggers=['booking_completed',
                    'rx_final','discharge'].
            (2) Trigger booking_completed: create a booking via POST
                /api/bookings (patient_phone=9000000123, patient_name=
                'Review Test'); then PATCH /api/bookings/{id}/status
                {status:'completed'}. After ≤90s, verify mongo has
                a `review_requests` row with trigger=booking_completed,
                phone=9000000123, status='sent' (delay=0). Also verify
                a notifications row with title beginning '⭐ Loved
                your visit?'.
            (3) Trigger rx_final: POST /api/prescriptions with same
                phone, status='final'. Same dedup window — should
                NOT create a second nudge for the same patient within
                7 days. Verify GET /api/review-requests/summary
                still shows count=1 for trigger=booking_completed and
                NO new rx_final row.
            (4) Force a different patient → POST /api/prescriptions
                {patient_phone:'9000000124', status:'final'} →
                verify a rx_final review_request row appears + sent.
            (5) Trigger discharge: PATCH /api/surgeries/{id}/status
                with status=completed + date_of_discharge=today (use
                a fresh test patient phone 9000000125). Verify a
                discharge review_request row appears + sent.
            (6) GET /api/review-requests/me/pending — sign in as one
                of the patient phones (e.g. via /api/auth/me with a
                phone match) → should return {pending:true, request_id,
                review_url}. POST /api/review-requests/{id}/ack →
                subsequent /me/pending returns {pending:false}.
            (7) Dedup: re-trigger booking_completed for same patient
                within 7 days → no new row.
            (8) Disable: PATCH clinic-settings
                {google_review_request_enabled:false} → newly
                completed bookings should NOT schedule new rows.
            (9) Bad URL: PATCH {google_review_url:''} → new triggers
                should NOT schedule rows (no URL = skip).
            (10) Auth gates: GET /api/review-requests with no auth →
                401/403. POST manual without owner role → 403.
            (11) CLEANUP: delete all test bookings/Rx/surgeries/
                review_requests/notifications created during testing.
                Restore clinic-settings to
                {google_review_request_enabled:false,
                 google_review_url:'',
                 google_review_delay_hours:24} so the live app
                doesn't accidentally start nudging real patients.
      - working: true
        agent: "testing"
        comment: |

          /app/backend_test_review_requests.py against the public
          EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://urology-pro.preview.emergentagent.com/api)

    message: |
      ## Session 5.13 — Push fix + Compact More menu + rclone mobile guide

      **1. Push notifications — root cause + fix**
      `/api/push/diagnostics` showed `total_tokens: 0` despite the
      stack being healthy. Root cause: `app.json` was committed with
      the literal placeholder `projectId: "REPLACE_WITH_PROJECT_ID_FROM_EAS_INIT"`.
      `Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({ projectId })` therefore
      silently failed on every device, so no token was ever sent to
      the backend.
      Restored the real EAS projectId
      `1e1764aa-2d2c-48c5-be82-1427eae229ea` (recovered from git
      history). Existing APK builds in the wild still carry the

    message: |

      **1. Primary Owner couldn't create blog posts (P0 fix)**
      Bug: `require_blog_writer` and `/api/me/tier` required the
      `can_create_blog` flag to be explicitly TRUE on every
      primary_owner. Newly-promoted owners (and the legacy seed) have
      a missing flag = treated as False, so the admin UI rendered the
      locked banner.

      Policy change (per user request):
      - Default-True for owner-tier roles (super_owner / primary_owner
        / partner). A missing flag = blog access GRANTED.
      - Super-owner can still REVOKE by explicitly setting
        `can_create_blog: false` (PATCH /api/admin/primary-owners/{id}/blog-perm).
      - Team members get the privilege via `can_manage_blog: true`,
        and the team-router now refuses to grant that flag unless the
        ACTOR (the primary_owner doing the granting) themselves has
        blog access — silent downgrade prevented; returns 403 with a
        clear message.

  - agent: main
    message: |
      ## Session 5.15 — In-app rclone wizard + Login-gated payments + Razorpay quick-start

      **1. Google Drive backup mirror — Path A in-app wizard (NEW)**
      Owner can now connect Google Drive without ever touching SSH /
      Termux. 3-step flow:
        Step 1 — Tap "Authorize Google Drive" → opens
          https://rclone.org/authorize/?type=drive&scope=drive
          in the device browser. User signs in → Allow → copies the
          JSON token shown on the success page.
        Step 2 — Returns to ConsultUro, pastes token + folder name,
          taps "Connect Drive".
        Step 3 — Success card; the off-host mirror flips green.

      Backend (new endpoints under `/api/admin/backup/mirror/`):
        - GET  /info        → installer state + current config (owner)
        - POST /connect     → validates JSON token, writes rclone.conf,
                              creates the Drive folder, persists
                              BACKUP_MIRROR_MODE=rclone +
                              RCLONE_REMOTE=gdrive:<folder> +
                              RCLONE_CONFIG path into /app/backend/.env,
                              refreshes os.environ in-process, and
                              runs an initial mirror push.
        - POST /test        → re-runs mirror_backups.sh on demand.
        - POST /disconnect  → strips the [gdrive] block, sets MODE=none.
      `rclone v1.60.1` installed in the container (apt).

      Frontend:
        - `src/gdrive-wizard.tsx` (new) — Modal with step indicator,
          token textarea, folder field, status / error / success card.
        - `src/backup-health-panel.tsx` — replaced the SSH instructions
          with a green "Set up Google Drive" CTA; once connected,
          shows a smaller "Manage Google Drive" button to re-enter the
          wizard for replace-token / disconnect.

      **2. Login compulsory for payments**
      Payments now require a signed-in user — protects the patient
      from anonymous charges and ensures we can persist a receipt +
      send confirmation push / SMS.

      Frontend:
        - `src/pay-button.tsx` — if `useAuth().user` is null, tapping
          opens a "Sign in required" prompt (Alert on native,
          `window.confirm` on web), then routes to `/login` with a
          `returnTo` deep link carrying every Pay param so the user
          lands back on /pay after auth.
        - `app/pay.tsx` — if a user reaches /pay anonymously (e.g.
          via deep link / browser back from logout), we render a
          dedicated Sign-in card instead of the checkout iframe.
        - `app/login.tsx` — accepts `?returnTo=/pay?...` via
          useLocalSearchParams, sanitises it (must start with /), and
          all post-auth router.replace() calls now go through a new
          `routeAfterAuth()` helper that respects the returnTo target.

      Backend gate (already in place): `/api/payments/razorpay/order`
      and `/verify` use `Depends(require_user)`.

      **3. Razorpay quick-start**
      Reused `/app/scripts/RAZORPAY_SETUP_GUIDE.md` from session 5.14.
      Test-mode keys live at:
        https://dashboard.razorpay.com/app/keys
      User reply format to paste back to the agent:
        RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=rzp_test_XXXX
        RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET=...
        RAZORPAY_MODE=test
      The agent will append to /app/backend/.env and restart.

      **Files changed**
      - backend/routers/admin_extras.py — 4 new endpoints + helpers.
      - frontend/src/gdrive-wizard.tsx — NEW modal wizard component.
      - frontend/src/backup-health-panel.tsx — wired the wizard CTA.
      - frontend/src/pay-button.tsx — login gate + Alert wrapper.
      - frontend/app/pay.tsx — Sign-in card for anonymous deep links.
      - frontend/app/login.tsx — returnTo deep-link sanitiser.

      - `rclone --version` → v1.60.1.
      - Endpoint /api/admin/backup/mirror/info reachable (returns
        rclone_installed:true, configured:false until user runs flow).

              → EXPECTED 502/504 (rclone rejects bad credentials at
              Google).
              → ACTUAL  400 (regex mismatch).            ❌ REGRESSION

              ROOT CAUSE — REGEX BUG at admin_extras.py:204
                _RCLONE_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
                    r'^\s*\{[\s\S]+"access_token"\s*:\s*"[^"]+"',
                    re.MULTILINE,
                )
              `[\s\S]+` requires ≥1 character between `{` and the
              literal "access_token". In a real rclone/Google OAuth
              JSON the FIRST key is normally access_token, e.g.
                {"access_token":"ya29.a0AfH6...","token_type":"Bearer",
                 "refresh_token":"...","expiry":"..."}
              The current regex REJECTS these tokens with 400.

              IMPACT — Production blocker: any user who pastes the
              real JSON token from rclone's web authorize page will
              hit a "doesn't look like the rclone authorization
              token" error before the actual rclone validation even
              runs. The wizard's happy path is unreachable.

              REPRO (positive control — token re-ordered so
              access_token isn't first):
                POST /api/admin/backup/mirror/connect with
                  {"refresh_token":"x","access_token":"fake","token_type":"Bearer","expiry":"2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
                → 502 "Could not reach Google Drive with that token.
                       rclone said: ... Error 401: Request had invalid
                       authentication credentials ..."
              i.e. once the regex is bypassed, the rclone path
              correctly returns 502 as the review brief expected.

              FIX (1-char) — change `[\s\S]+` to `[\s\S]*` (or, more
              robustly, parse the JSON first and look for
              `obj.get("access_token")`):
                _RCLONE_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
                    r'^\s*\{[\s\S]*"access_token"\s*:\s*"[^"]+"',
                    re.MULTILINE,
                )

      command, not a public web page. The 5.15 paste-token flow was
      unreachable for normal users. Rebuilt as a proper Google Cloud
      OAuth 2.0 flow using the clinic's own client credentials.

      **1. Backups routing fixes**
      - More tab → Backups was pointing to `/admin/backups` (no
        screen file). Now points to `/dashboard?tab=backups`.
      - Same fix in `src/web-shell.tsx` for desktop sidebar.

        - DELETE /api/admin/backup/mirror/oauth/client   — super-owner only

        - GET    /api/admin/backup/mirror/oauth/callback — Google redirect target
      `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` added to backend .env so we can
      compute the redirect URI without guessing.

      Flow on success:
      1. Frontend opens consent URL via Linking.openURL.
      2. Google → /oauth/callback?code&state.

         with [gdrive] block containing the user's client_id/secret +
         token JSON, persists BACKUP_MIRROR_MODE/RCLONE_REMOTE in
         /app/backend/.env, refreshes os.environ in-process, runs a
         best-effort initial mirror push.
      4. Renders an on-brand HTML success card with

  - agent: main
    message: |
      ## Session 5.18 — Practice grid + Medical Certificates + Pending Payment

      User had 9 follow-ups; Phase 1 (rclone wizard + Razorpay
      webhook guide) is complete (held by user for OAuth setup).
      This turn shipped Phase 2 + part of Phase 3.

      **A. Backups menu navigation fix (#1, #9)**
      - More tab + desktop sidebar were routing Backups to
        `/admin/backups` (non-existent). Now → `/dashboard?tab=backups`.

      **B. Practice section grid layout (#6)**
      `app/(tabs)/more.tsx` — converted Practice from a flat list to a
      gridMode block matching Administration:
        - Clinical (Consults, Rx) — teal
        - Surgical (Surgeries, OT, Consents) — purple
        - Money (Billing) — green
        - Comms (Inbox, Broadcasts) — sky
        - Productivity (Notes, Reminders) — amber
        - Certificates (Medical Certificate, new!) — gold
      Each row carries a `color` prop so the icon tile and accent
      hint match the chosen palette.

      **C. Medical Certificate generator (#5)**
      Complete new module:
      - `backend/routers/medical_certificates.py` — collection +
        CRUD + soft-delete + tenant filtering. Owner-tier or
        any prescriber may issue; patients see only their own.
        4 kinds: sick_leave, fitness, unfit_for_duty, medical_summary.
      - Mounted in `backend/server.py`.
      - `frontend/app/medical-certificates/index.tsx` — list +
        composer + preview modal. Premium PDF generator
        (`src/medical-cert-pdf.ts`) outputs an A4 letterhead with:
          * Gold accent strip (DOC_THEME.medical_certificate)
          * Clinic header + official seal motif
          * Kind-specific narrative (sick leave, fitness, etc.)
          * Doctor signature block + registration number
          * Watermark badge + footer rule
      - Added to Practice grid → /medical-certificates.

      **D. Document color theming foundation (#7)**
      New: `frontend/src/doc-theme.ts` — single source of truth.
      Each generated document type has:
        prescription         teal   #0E7C8B
        receipt              green  #16A34A
        admission            indigo #4F46E5
        discharge            purple #7C3AED
        medical_certificate  gold   #CA8A04
        daily_progress       sky    #0EA5E9
        consent              rose   #E11D48
        investigation_report slate  #475569
      Medical Certificate already uses this. Other generators to be
      migrated in a follow-up (mostly cosmetic — strip + badge
      changes).

      **E. Pending Payment workflow (#3)**
      Backend (`routers/bookings.py`):
      - `BookingCreate` model: new `pending_offline:bool` field.
      - On creation, if staff sets it true → booking lands with
        `payment_status:"pending_offline"`. Anonymous self-bookings
        ignore the flag (security: patients can't avoid payment by
        flipping a body field).
      - `POST /api/bookings/{id}/mark-paid-offline` — records cash/
        UPI/card/other payment with notes. Defaults amount to
        `clinic_settings.consultation_fee_inr`. Idempotent (paid
        bookings return their current state). Requires
        `can_manage_billing` or owner-tier.
      - `POST /api/bookings/{id}/mark-payment-pending` — reverts an
        offline-paid booking back to pending. Refuses to undo real
        Razorpay payments (400 + suggests refund flow).

      Frontend:
      - `app/(tabs)/book.tsx` — staff-only "Hold payment — collect
        at the desk on visit day" checkbox (only renders if the
        logged-in user is an owner-tier or staff role).
      - `app/bookings/[id].tsx` — when status is `pending_offline`:
        amber "Pending payment (offline)" chip + green
        `MarkPaidOfflineButton` (modal with amount / mode chips /
        notes). Falls back to existing PayButton otherwise.

      **Tests** — backend_test_session_5_18.py: 50/50 PASS
        - All medical-certificate CRUD assertions
        - All pending-payment flow assertions (incl. role gating,
          idempotency, Razorpay-refusal guardrail)
        - Razorpay / blog-policy / OAuth regressions unchanged.

      **Held by user**
      - Google Cloud OAuth setup (item from Phase 1) — user said
        "hold setup for Google Cloud OAuth, resume other work".
        Backend OAuth wizard endpoints are ready and tested; user
        will return to this when they create the OAuth client.
      - Razorpay webhook secret — guide written, awaiting user paste.

      **Files changed**

        - backend/routers/bookings.py (BookingCreate + 2 endpoints)
        - backend/models.py (pending_offline field)
        - backend/server.py (router mount)
        - frontend/app/(tabs)/more.tsx (Practice grid + colors)
        - frontend/app/(tabs)/book.tsx (Hold-payment toggle)
        - frontend/app/bookings/[id].tsx (pending chip + Mark-paid)
        - frontend/app/medical-certificates/index.tsx (NEW screen)
        - frontend/src/doc-theme.ts (NEW palette)
        - frontend/src/medical-cert-pdf.ts (NEW PDF generator)
        - frontend/src/web-shell.tsx (backups route fix)
        - frontend/src/gdrive-wizard.tsx (OAuth flow rewrite)
