backend_patient_lookup_medcert_smoke_2026_06_01:
  - task: "Patient-lookup endpoint + Medical Certificate extended fields"
    implemented: true
    working: false
    file: "/app/backend/routers/patients.py, /app/backend/routers/patient_db.py, /app/backend/routers/medical_certificates.py"
    stuck_count: 1
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: false
        agent: "testing"
        comment: |
          Smoke run via /app/backend_test_patient_lookup_medcert.py
          against http://localhost:8001 with primary_owner token
          (test_session_1776770314741). 27/38 assertions PASS, 11 FAIL.

          ❌ CRITICAL — /api/patients/lookup is SHADOWED.
          Two routers register GET /api/patients/lookup:
            • routers/patients.py:22       (registered FIRST  → wins)
            • routers/patient_db.py:282    (registered SECOND → unreachable)
          server.py:3326 includes _patients_router before
          server.py:3327 includes _patient_db_router, so the older
          phone-only endpoint shadows the newer compact resolver that
          the review request expects.

          Observed behaviour against the live route (patients.py):
            A1 no-auth                        → 401     ✅ (expected 401/403)
            A2 no params                      → 400 "Phone required"
                                                 (expected 200 found:false)         ❌
            A3 POST /api/bookings + reg-no    → reg_no=007010626                    ✅
            A4 ?phone=+919999111122           → 200 {"found":false,"phone":"…"}     ❌
                                                 (patient row EXISTS in db.patients
                                                 with phone="9999111122",
                                                 reg_no="007010626", name="Lookup
                                                 Test" — confirmed via mongosh)
            A5 ?registration_no=007010626     → 400 "Phone required"
                                                 (endpoint has no reg-no support)    ❌
            A6 ?phone=non-existent            → 200 {"found":false}                  ✅

          ❌ ROOT-CAUSE #1 — Route shadowing.
            routers/patients.py owns `/api/patients/lookup` because it's
            included first. patient_db.py's richer endpoint never runs.

          ❌ ROOT-CAUSE #2 — Tenant filter on `patients` collection.
            patients.py applies
              `tenant_filter(user, clinic_id, allow_global=True)`
            which evaluates to `{"clinic_id": "clinic_a97b903f2fb2"}`
            because the primary_owner has a default clinic membership.
            BUT db.patients documents do not carry clinic_id —
            services/reg_no.allocate_reg_no() writes only
            {phone, name, reg_no, email, updated_at, first_seen_at}.
            Verified via mongosh: the test patient row exists with
            those fields and no clinic_id. The filter therefore
            returns 0 rows even for a phone that clearly maps to a
            known patient. This is a SECOND independent bug — even if
            the route shadowing were resolved, patients.py's lookup
            would still return found:false against the existing
            (un-clinicked) records.

          ✅ patient_db.py would have worked. Confirmed indirectly by
            hitting `GET /api/patient-db/by-phone/+919999111122`:
              200 {"profile":{"phone":"9999111122","name":"Lookup Test",
                              "reg_no":"007010626", …}, "bookings":[…], …}
            i.e. the data is reachable; only the `/api/patients/lookup`
            entry-point is broken.

          ✅ MEDICAL CERTIFICATE EXTENDED FIELDS — fully working.
            POST /api/medical-certificates with the spec payload
            (kind=sick_leave, registration_no=007010626,
             patient_email="test@x.com",
             patient_address="12 Cherry Lane, Ahmedabad",
             patient_age=40, patient_gender="M",
             diagnosis="Acute viral fever", advice="Bed rest",
             start_date="2026-06-20", days=3) → 200.
            All new fields persisted in the response:
              registration_no, patient_email, patient_address,
              patient_age, patient_gender, diagnosis, days, kind.
            GET /api/medical-certificates/{id} → 200, every field
            round-tripped exactly.
            PUT with only {patient_address:"New address", kind,
                           patient_name} → 200, address updated,
            patient_phone preserved (exclude_unset honoured).
            DELETE /api/medical-certificates/{id} (owner) → 200,
            soft-delete OK.

          ✅ REGRESSION SPOT CHECKS:
            GET /api/health                → 200
            GET /api/blog                  → 200 (list of posts)
            GET /api/discharge-summaries   → 200
            POST /api/bookings             → 200 (auto-allocates reg_no)
            DELETE /api/bookings/{id}      → 200 (cleanup OK)
            /api/razorpay/key              → 404 (NOTE: the canonical
              razorpay key is exposed at /api/payments/razorpay/config
              which was confirmed working in earlier sessions — see
              backend_gdrive_oauth_wizard_smoke_2026_04_29 row).

          REQUIRED FIXES (main agent):
          1. DELETE the duplicate `/api/patients/lookup` route in
             /app/backend/routers/patients.py (the older phone-only
             version). The richer implementation in
             /app/backend/routers/patient_db.py:282 already supports
             phone OR registration_no and returns 200 + found:false
             on missing params — which is exactly what the review
             request requires. Once removed, the
             routers/patient_db.py route becomes the canonical handler.
             (Alternative: rename the patients.py route to e.g.
             `/api/patients/lookup-by-phone` if the older shape is
             still needed by some frontend caller.)
          2. (Optional but recommended) Audit whether any caller still
             depends on the old patients.py response shape
             ({found:false, phone:...}). patient_db.py's lookup returns
             {found, phone, name, registration_no, age, gender, email,
              address, first_seen_at} — a superset, but the legacy
             shape's `phone` key (returned even on found:false) and the
             status code on missing params differ.
          3. After the fix, re-run /app/backend_test_patient_lookup_medcert.py
             — all 11 currently failing assertions should pass without
             any other change.

          End-state: test booking + test cert deleted via the test's
          cleanup. db.patients row for 9999111122 (reg_no=007010626)
          left in place (it was created by the legitimate booking
          flow). No 5xx leaked into supervisor logs.

      ## Session 5.23 — Print button → real PDF (not print dialog)

      User reported the "Print PDF" button on the Medical Certificate
      and Discharge Summary screens was opening the OS / browser

      share / save / WhatsApp.

      that uses the established server-side WeasyPrint pipeline:
        - Web    → POST /api/render/pdf (HTML→PDF) → Blob → tries
                  Web Share API first; falls back to `<a download>`
                  → Downloads folder.
        - Native → expo-print.printToFileAsync (generates a real
                  .pdf in cache) → expo-sharing share sheet

    message: |
      **Phase 4.X — Receipt "Print" → Real PDF + Surgery Scheduler patient auto-lookup**

      ## 1. Receipt PDF bug fix
      The Receipt detail screen had three actions: Print, PDF, Share.
      The legacy `Print` button was driving the OS / browser print
      dialog via `printReceipt()` (which uses an iframe + window.print()
      on web). Doctors repeatedly closed that dialog without saving and
      asked for a real PDF file.

      Fix:
      - `app/billing/[id].tsx`: removed the redundant "Print" action
        and the `onPrint` handler. Bottom bar now exposes:
          • Download PDF (existing `downloadReceiptPdf` — WeasyPrint
            blob on web, expo-print + sharing on native)
          • Share PDF (existing `shareReceiptPdf` — Web Share API on
            web, expo-sharing on native)
          • Delete (owner only)
      - `app/billing/new.tsx`: "Save & Print" CTA now calls
        `shareReceiptPdf(receipt)` (real PDF + share sheet) and is
        relabeled "Save & Share PDF" with a share-social icon.
      - `src/receipt-pdf.ts` keeps `printReceipt` exported for back-
        compat but it's no longer referenced anywhere in the UI.

      ## 2. Surgery Scheduler — patient auto-lookup
      User asked: "Surgery log entry should also fetch patient details
      on entering Registration Number or Mobile number. It must be in
      sync with Consent, IPD details & other fields."

      `app/ot-calendar/schedule.tsx` Step-1 redesigned to match the
      Medical Cert / IPD flow:
      - New helper text at top: "Enter phone or registration number
        — we auto-fetch the rest from your patient database."
      - Phone (flex 2) + Reg. No. (flex 1) on the same row, both with
        `onBlur` → `tryLookup({ phone })` / `tryLookup({ registration_no })`.
      - `tryLookup` hits GET `/api/patients/lookup` and auto-fills
        name, age, sex, email, address, registration_no (only when
        those fields are still empty — preserves doctor edits).
      - Looking-up spinner + "Auto-filled from patient database · ..."
        or "No matching record found" status hint.
      - Added Address (multiline) and Email fields to Step-1.
      - Surgery payload now sends `registration_no`, `address`,
        `patient_email` so backend persists / updates `patients`
        collection consistently (backend already accepted these
        fields via `SurgeryBody`).
      - Booking-id prefill path additionally calls `tryLookup`
        (fire-and-forget) so reg_no / address fill in even when only
        a booking id was passed.
      - Edit path now restores `registration_no` / `address` /
        `patient_email` from the existing surgery doc.

      ## Files changed

      - frontend/app/billing/new.tsx
      - frontend/app/ot-calendar/schedule.tsx

      ## Testing requested

      Backend `/api/patients/lookup` + `/api/surgeries` POST/PATCH

      `registration_no` / `address` / `patient_email` on `SurgeryBody`.

  - agent: "main"
    message: |
      **Phase 5.10 — Billing & Receipts hardening + Razorpay integration**

      Four user-reported issues addressed in one pass:

      ## 1. Billing Settings ↔ Record Payment template mismatch (P0)
      Root cause: `fetchClinicSettings()` in `src/clinic-settings.ts`
      caches for 5 min. After saving in Billing Settings, the Record
      Payment screen still served the stale catalogue.

      Fix in `frontend/app/billing/new.tsx`:
        - On every mount, call `fetchClinicSettings(true)` (force=true)
          to bypass the cache.
        - Seed the very first line item's amount with the saved
          `consultation_fee_inr` (Quick default in Billing Settings)
          so the doctor doesn't have to type ₹800 every time.
        - Inherit `billing_gst_pct_default` for the GST percent input.

      ## 2. Razorpay "Authentication failed" on patient Pay (P0)
      User supplied fresh Test mode credentials. Updated `/app/backend/.env`:
        RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=rzp_test_SwKJbGYwyHwIVQ
        RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET=a0X2o5pIQxAY5e6LqvLYjiyo
      `/api/payments/razorpay/config` confirmed `enabled:true` with the
      new key_id after backend restart.

      ## 3. Pending-payment bookings in Billing & Receipts (P1)

      New backend endpoint:
        `GET /api/bookings/pending-payments` (staff-only, tenant-scoped)
        Returns confirmed bookings where payment_status ∈ {
          pending_offline, null, "" } AND paid_offline ≠ True.
        Each row enriched with an `amount_inr` derived from the matching
        fee_catalog default (consultation_fee_inr / follow_up_fee_inr /
        video_consultation_fee_inr).

      Frontend `app/billing/index.tsx` — new "Pending payments"
      collapsible card pinned ABOVE the daily collection hero. Each row
      shows patient + booking date/time + reason + amount + a "Settle
      now" CTA. "Settle now" deep-links to
        /billing/new?booking_id=…&patient_phone=…&patient_name=…&amount=…
      pre-filled and ready to save.

      On receipt save, `billing/new.tsx` calls
        POST /api/bookings/{booking_id}/mark-paid-offline
      so the booking flips to `paid` and disappears from the pending
      list (handled the new Razorpay-tagged + UPI-direct mode strings
      in the endpoint's mode normaliser).

      ## 4. Razorpay-backed payment modes in Record Payment (P1)

      ### Backend
      `routers/receipts.py` — expanded allowed `mode` set to:
        Cash · UPI · Card · Wallet · Cheque · Other
        UPI (Direct) · UPI (Razorpay) · Card (Razorpay) · Wallet (Razorpay)
        Pending Razorpay
      `routers/razorpay_pay.py` —`_mark_target_paid()` now accepts the
      raw Razorpay payment object and translates `method` into the
      friendly receipt mode label, sets `mode`/`payment_ref`/`paid`/
      `balance` on the receipt. Both `/verify` and `/webhook` pass the
      raw payment object through.

      ### Frontend
      `app/billing/new.tsx`:
        - Manual mode chips: Cash · UPI (Direct) · Cheque · Other
        - New "Or take payment online" dashed-border section with a
          "Charge ₹X via Razorpay" CTA. On click:
            1. Save receipt with mode="Pending Razorpay", paid=0

  - agent: "main"
    message: |
      **Phase 5.11 — Mobile polish + UX fixes (4 user reports)**

      ## 1. Gray-gradient icon bubbles on Android — More tab + Branding
      Root cause: `MenuGrid` rendered the tile icon bubble with
      `accent + '18'` (~9% alpha) and `elevation:1`. On Android the
      elevation shadow + the very pale tint combined to produce a
      visible gray gradient under each icon.
      Fix in `src/menu-grid.tsx`:
        - Bubble bg: `accent + '18'` → `accent + '33'` (~20% alpha)
        - Bubble border: `accent + '40'` → `accent + '66'` (~40% alpha)
        - Dropped `Platform.select` shadow / `elevation:1` from the
          iconBubble so no gradient appears underneath.
      Practice + Administration tiles now render with a clean colored
      pill on both iOS and Android.

      ## 2. Google Reviews carousel missing between Latest Videos & Connect
      Root cause: `FeaturedReviewsCarousel` returned `null` when both
      items list AND `cta.review_url` were empty — collapsing the
      section entirely on a clinic that hadn't configured Google
      review URL yet.
      Fix in `src/featured-reviews-carousel.tsx`:
        - Empty-state now ALWAYS renders the gold `EmptyReviewsCta`
          card (patients + anon users) so the homepage flow stays
          intact between Latest Videos → carousel → Connect.
        - When `review_url` is present, button reads "Write the first
          review" and opens Google Maps review form.
        - When `review_url` is absent, button reads "Share feedback"
          and routes to the internal `/reviews` page where patients
          can leave structured feedback.

      ## 3. Tablet / landscape orientation
      `frontend/app.json` — `orientation: "portrait"` → `"default"`.
      All Android phones, tablets, foldables and iPads now respect
      device rotation. iOS already had `supportsTablet: true`.

      ## 4. Video Consultation card on in-person bookings
      Root cause: `app/bookings/[id].tsx` mounted `<VideoCallActions>`
      for ANY active booking (so doctor could spin up an ad-hoc call).
      User explicitly does NOT want this on in-person visits.
      Fix: condition now requires `isVideo && status not in
      {rejected, cancelled}`. The card disappears entirely for
      `mode === 'in-person'` bookings.

      ## Files changed
      - frontend/src/menu-grid.tsx (bubble opacity + no shadow)
      - frontend/src/featured-reviews-carousel.tsx (empty-state always
        renders; "Share feedback" fallback)
      - frontend/app.json (orientation: default)
      - frontend/app/bookings/[id].tsx (isVideo gate on VideoCallActions)
      - frontend/app/billing/new.tsx (primary CTA relabelled
        "Record Payment" per user feedback)

      ## Testing
      No backend changes. Frontend testing PENDING user approval.


  - agent: "main"
    message: |
      **Phase A + B (start) — Prescription "Not found" bug + universal keyboard handling**

      ## Phase A · Prescription "Not found" for patients (P0 BUG FIX)
      Root cause: `GET /api/prescriptions/{id}` ownership check only
      matched on `user_id` and `registration_no`. Most patient
      prescriptions are created BEFORE the patient signs up, so
      `patient_user_id` is empty on the doc — and the patient's
      `registration_no` is often blank in the user profile. The check
      therefore returned 404 even though `/me` listed the Rx (the list
      endpoint matches by phone digits).

      Fix in `backend/routers/prescriptions.py`:
      - `GET /api/prescriptions/{id}` now ALSO matches on last-10
        phone digits between the authenticated user and the Rx's
        `patient_phone`. Falls back to extracting digits from the raw
        `phone` field for legacy users who pre-date the `phone_digits`
        column.
      - `GET /api/prescriptions/me` extended to include `registration_no`
        matches in the `$or` so My Records stays in sync.

      With the 404 fixed, the patient's PDF Download / Share buttons
      light up naturally (they were dimmed because `rx` state was null
      after the failed fetch). No frontend change needed for the
      download flow.

      ## Phase B · Universal keyboard handling (start)
      Goal: every form input is always visible above the on-screen
      keyboard — no more typing blind.

      Two-pronged fix applied at the framework level (so EVERY screen
      that already uses `<SafeScreen>` benefits without per-screen
      churn):

      1. `frontend/app.json` → `android.softwareKeyboardLayoutMode:
         "resize"`. Android now resizes the entire window when the IME
         opens, so ScrollViews naturally scroll the focused input into
         view rather than the keyboard painting over the form.
         **Requires a native rebuild** to take effect on installed APK.

      2. `frontend/src/safe-screen.tsx`:
         - `shouldAvoid` default flipped to `true` on BOTH iOS and
           Android (was iOS-only). `KeyboardAvoidingView` behavior is
           now platform-correct (`padding` on iOS, `height` on Android).
         - The internal `ScrollView` (when `scroll` prop is on) now
           passes `automaticallyAdjustKeyboardInsets={true}` on iOS so
           UIKit auto-scrolls focused inputs above the keyboard.

      3. `frontend/app/ipd.tsx` migrated from a bare `SafeAreaView` +
         manual `ScrollView` to `<SafeScreen scroll>`, picking up:
           • Top notch / status-bar padding
           • Android gesture pill clearance on the bottom
           • Keyboard avoidance + auto-scroll on focused input

      ## Files changed
      - backend/routers/prescriptions.py (ownership check + /me phone &
        registration_no matching)
      - frontend/app.json (softwareKeyboardLayoutMode=resize)
      - frontend/src/safe-screen.tsx (keyboard avoidance on both
        platforms; iOS auto-adjust-insets)
      - frontend/app/ipd.tsx (use SafeScreen)

      ## Backend testing requested
      - GET /api/prescriptions/{id} as patient — should now return the
        doc when patient_phone digits match (legacy + new flows)
      - GET /api/prescriptions/me — should include Rx matched by
        registration_no even when phone is missing
      - Confirm staff/owner still get any Rx (no regression)
      - Negative path: patient with mismatched phone/reg should still
        get 404 (no auth bypass)

      Frontend testing PENDING user approval. Phase C/D/E/F (Medical
      Cert revamp, IPD polish, AI integration, Discharge Summary
      expansion) will come in subsequent rounds.

  - agent: "main"
    message: |
      **Phase 5.13 — Video Consultation in-app + role-aware notifications**

      Four user reports addressed in one pass:

      ## 1 + 2. Notifications now carry role-aware deep-links
      `backend/routers/bookings.py` — when a confirmed booking
      auto-provisions a 100ms room, we now push TWO notifications:

      a) **Patient push + bell**
         data = {type:"video_room_ready", role:"patient",
                 patient_url, patient_code, code, link}
         Title: "Your video consultation link is ready 🎥"

      b) **Primary owner / doctor push + bell**
         Backend queries `db.users` for primary_owner / super_owner /
         owner roles and pushes the HOST link to every one of them:
         data = {type:"video_room_ready", role:"doctor",
                 doctor_url, doctor_code, code, link}
         Title: "Video room is ready · join as host 🎥"

      The `link` field is a generic alias so older clients (without
      the new tap handler) fall back to opening the URL.

      ## 3. Join Video Consultation button on the appointment page
      Already present in `src/video-call-actions.tsx`:
        - Patient: "Join now" CTA → routes to
          `/video/[code]?role=patient` with the patient_code.
        - Staff / Primary owner: "Join as doctor" CTA → now routes to
          `/video/[code]?role=doctor` with doctor_code (previously
          opened `WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync` which violated the
          "no pop-up browser" requirement).

      ## 4. Whole video consultation opens INSIDE the app
      The `/video/[code]` screen was already an in-app WebView render
      of the 100ms prebuilt room (`react-native-webview` + Stack
      header + clinic-branded pre-call screen). We rewired the staff
      side so they also use this in-app screen instead of
      `WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync`.

      ## Notification tap handler (frontend/app/_layout.tsx)
      Added two new branches:
        - `type === 'video_room_ready'` → resolves the role-specific
          code (doctor_code OR patient_code OR last-path-segment of
          the matching URL) and `router.push`es to
          `/video/[code]?role=...&bookingId=...`. Falls back to
          `Linking.openURL(link)` if a code can't be derived.
        - Generic fallback at the END of the handler: any other
          notification carrying a `link` field opens it
          (`Linking.openURL` for `http(s)://`, `router.push` for
          internal `/paths`). Covers promotional pushes.

      Added a tiny `extractCodeFromUrl` helper inside
      `app/_layout.tsx` for the 100ms URL → code fallback.

      ## Files changed
      - backend/routers/bookings.py (dual role-aware notifications +
        codes embedded in data)
      - frontend/src/video-call-actions.tsx ("Join as doctor" routes
        to /video/[code]?role=doctor)
      - frontend/app/_layout.tsx (notification tap handler for
        `video_room_ready` + generic link fallback)

          services/notifications.create_notification(), the

          lookup `{phone: "9876543210"}` against db.users, but
          existing user rows store phone as "+919876543210" with

          flow upstream correctly links user_id and the

          notification-fallback feature was introduced.

        Observed (pre-existing, NOT a Phase 5.13 regression):
        services/notifications.create_notification falls back to a
        non-normalised phone equality lookup. Bookings store
        patient_phone="9876543210" while users store
        phone="+919876543210"; the fallback therefore misses the
        registered patient unless the booking also carries
        patient_email (which DOES populate user_id at create-time).
        Effect: when a staff member books a video appointment for
        a registered patient by phone-only, the patient row in
        notifications is silently skipped. Suggested fix in main
        agent's note above — but this is independent of the
        Phase 5.13 changes which are themselves complete and
        correct.

  - agent: "main"
    message: |
      **Phase 5.14 — In-person vs Video booking segregation on doctor + staff side**

      Per user request: staff and doctor should be able to view
      In-person consultations separately from Video consultations.

      ## Frontend
      ### `src/home/staff-bookings-screen.tsx` (Home → Today / Upcoming)
      - New `ModeFilter` state ('all' | 'in_person' | 'video').
      - New `ModePill` component (icon + label + count) with tinted
        active styling — sky-blue for In-person, purple for Video,
        primary for All.
      - Second pill row rendered below the existing Today / Upcoming
        row, showing live counts for each mode.
      - Visible list now applies both filters before slicing to the
        top-12 cards.

      ### `src/dashboard/bookings-panel.tsx` (Full bookings page)
      - Added the same `modeFilter` state and three chip row below
        the status filter dropdown. Counts reflect the currently
        chosen status (e.g. "Pending → In-person (4) / Video (2)").
      - Filter is applied between status filter and search filter so
        all downstream views (Day / Week / Month / Map) inherit the
        segregation.

      Both screens use the canonical `isVideoBooking()` helper from
      `src/consultation-window.ts` (mode === 'online' OR starts with
      'video') so In-person and Video bucketing is consistent across
      the codebase.

      ## Files changed
      - frontend/src/home/staff-bookings-screen.tsx
      - frontend/src/dashboard/bookings-panel.tsx

      Backend untouched. No new endpoints required — filter is
      client-side on the same `/api/bookings/all` payload.

      Frontend testing PENDING user approval.


  - agent: "main"
    message: |
      **Phase 5.14.1 — Video booking misclassified as In-person after confirmation (bug fix)**

      ## Root cause
      The backend `routers/bookings.py` auto-provision helper (line 73)
      **overwrites** the booking's `mode` field from `"online"` to
      `"video"` once a 100ms room is created on confirm. The frontend's
      canonical `isVideoBooking()` helper in `consultation-window.ts`
      strictly compared `mode === 'online'`, so any confirmed video
      booking flipped into the In-person bucket on the staff dashboard
      (Phase 5.14 chip group + the older mode badge across My Records,
      My Bookings, Timeline, Appointment detail, etc.).

      ## Fix
      Single source of truth — `src/consultation-window.ts`
      `isVideoBooking()` now accepts BOTH `'online'` and `'video'`
      (case-insensitive) plus anything starting with `'video'`. JSDoc
      explains the two-value reality so future devs don't regress.

      ## Companion fixes — every surface that did a strict
      `mode === 'online'` comparison was updated to accept `'video'`
      too:
        - frontend/src/home/staff-bookings-screen.tsx (mode chip on
          each booking row)
        - frontend/src/consultations-panel.tsx (Video/In-person mode tag)
        - frontend/app/bookings/[id].tsx (Mode row in patient detail)
        - frontend/app/timeline.tsx (subtitle line)
        - frontend/app/my-bookings.tsx (icon + label)
        - frontend/app/my-records.tsx (card meta line)
        - frontend/src/calendar.ts (Google-Calendar event "isOnline"
          decision — affects WhatsApp link vs map link)
        - frontend/src/booking-reminders.ts (reminder copy)

      ## Files changed
      - frontend/src/consultation-window.ts (canonical fix)
      - 7 call-site touch-ups listed above

      ## Backend testing requested
      Smoke-only — verify Phase 5.13's video notifications still fire
      both pushes (1 patient, 1 doctor) when a video booking is
      confirmed. The bookings mode field can still flip to "video"
      after confirm — that's expected; the regression only affected
      the frontend bucketing.

      Frontend testing PENDING user approval.



  - agent: "main"
    message: |
      **Crash-to-homepage hotfix — PHR monthly-summary 500 error**

      ## Symptom
      User reported: "The app repeatedly crashes to homepage. There is a
      serious bug. Fix this." Backend logs showed every call to
      `GET /api/patients/me/phr/monthly-summary` returning 500 with:

        TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes
          at routers/phr.py:270

      Reading from MongoDB strips tzinfo, so `cached["generated_at"]`
      came back UTC-naive while `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` is UTC-
      aware. The exception propagated through SlowAPI / CORS middleware
      stacks and showed up as a 500 to the patient app.

      ## Fix
      1) `backend/routers/phr.py` — normalise `cached["generated_at"]`
         to UTC-aware before subtraction. Falls through to fresh
         generation if cached row is missing or malformed.
      2) `backend/routers/admin_extras.py` — same class of bug at line
         847 (`st["created_at"]` from `gdrive_oauth_states`). Added a
         module-level `_ensure_utc_aware()` helper.

      ## Files changed
      - backend/routers/phr.py
      - backend/routers/admin_extras.py

      ## Backend testing requested
      Smoke-test `/api/patients/me/phr/monthly-summary` with a logged-in
      patient — should now return 200 (either cached or fresh).

  - agent: "main"
    message: |
      **🔴 Crash-to-homepage GLOBAL fix — OTA reload loop + DD-MM-YYYY pickers**

      ## Root cause (the BIG one)
      User reported: "app comes back to homepage in 5-10 seconds, on
      every page, on both patient and owner ends. No error, no banner,
      no flash." This pattern uniquely matches `Updates.reloadAsync()`
      — a silent cold restart that lands the user at "/".

      The previous `src/ota-updates.ts` did:
        1. On every cold start → check for OTA update.
        2. If isAvailable → fetch + 1.5s setTimeout → reloadAsync().
        3. Fresh cold start → check AGAIN → still isAvailable
           (runtime-version mismatch / rollback keeps re-advertising
           the same payload) → reload → ∞ loop.
        4. Also re-checked on every AppState='active' transition,
           which compounded the cycle on Android.

      ## Fix — `src/ota-updates.ts` (rewritten)
        1. Persistent **cooldown** (`AsyncStorage` key
           `@consulturo/ota.last-reload-ts.v1`, 10-minute window).
           After ANY successful reload, the next 10 minutes refuse to
           reload again. Breaks the cold-start → reload → cold-start
           ping-pong.
        2. **Same-manifest dedupe** — store the manifest id we just
           applied; on the next check, refuse to reload if the
           "available" manifest id matches what we already installed
           (the classic rollback signature).
        3. **Dropped the AppState='active' re-check** — cold-start
           check is sufficient and the AppState path was the second
           half of the loop.
        4. Added diagnostics (`getOtaDiagnostics`, `resetOtaCooldown`)
           for support / About-screen debugging.

      ## Companion task — DD-MM-YYYY + Date Picker everywhere
      User also asked: "All date display formatted as DD-MM-YYYY, all
      date input fields → native date picker, time in 12hr IST."

      The app already had:
        - `src/date.ts` → `UI_DATE_FORMAT='dd-MM-yyyy'`,
          `displayDate / displayDateTime / displayDateLong` all DD-MM-YYYY.
        - `src/date-picker.tsx` → `DateField` (UI value) +
          `TimeField` (12-h with AM/PM).
        - IST helpers (`formatIST`, `formatISTDate`, `formatISTTime`,
          `formatISTRelative`).

      Added a new `ISODateField` wrapper to `src/date-picker.tsx` that
      accepts/emits ISO yyyy-MM-dd strings — used everywhere the
      consumer state shape is ISO (most backend-bound forms).

      ## Files migrated to ISODateField / TimeField
        - `app/bookings/[id].tsx` — reschedule date picker (was raw
          TextInput with YYYY-MM-DD placeholder).
        - `app/medical-certificates/index.tsx` — 5 date inputs
          (consultation, admission, surgery, discharge, leave start,
          resume duty).
        - `app/discharge-summaries/index.tsx` — From / To filters +
          Follow-up date inside the edit modal.
        - `src/featured-reviews-admin-panel.tsx` — review date.
        - `src/ipd-panel.tsx` — Follow-up date in the discharge form.
        - `app/calculators/bladder-diary.tsx` — entry date + entry time
          (now uses TimeField for 12-h AM/PM input).

      Surgery panel + OT schedule + dashboard + my-records already
      used `DateField` / `displayDate` and need no change.

      ## Files changed
        - frontend/src/ota-updates.ts (REWRITTEN — crash fix)
        - frontend/src/date-picker.tsx (added ISODateField)
        - frontend/app/bookings/[id].tsx
        - frontend/app/medical-certificates/index.tsx
        - frontend/app/discharge-summaries/index.tsx
        - frontend/src/featured-reviews-admin-panel.tsx
        - frontend/src/ipd-panel.tsx
        - frontend/app/calculators/bladder-diary.tsx

      ## Verification
        - Metro bundler restarts cleanly; web preview loads home
          carousel without compilation errors (screenshot verified).
        - No backend changes in this hotfix beyond what was already
          applied for the PHR monthly-summary 500.

      ## Important note for user
      The OTA fix lives in JS but the **CURRENTLY-INSTALLED APK still
      has the buggy ota-updates.ts baked in**. Two ways to recover:
        1. Publish a new EAS Update (`eas update`) — the very next
          time the installed APK applies the update it will switch
          to the new logic and the loop ends FOREVER.
        2. Or rebuild + sideload a fresh APK from this codebase.

      Until the user applies one of the above, the installed APK will
      continue to loop. After that, the loop disappears even on
      runtime-version mismatch days.

      ## Backend testing requested
      No backend changes in this turn — backend is healthy. Skip
      backend testing unless explicitly requested.

      ## Frontend testing
      PENDING user approval — frontend changes are visual + new
      pickers. User wants APK behaviour fixed via OTA push.
